sourceIdentity: Base commit identifies ancestry only. Candidate is an uncommitted working tree; actual loaded response hashes identify each run.

configuration.intro: Train after 25 manual taps; first hire then 10 manual taps reveals Words and Titles; keeper consumption gated until that reveal; bot completes coach after first sale.
configuration.ordinaryPickup: Rounded to denomination 25; max of 125*(1+floor(visible game playSecs/600)) and two seconds of sustained royalty+division base income; only eligible after intro on Floor.
configuration.profile: Active taps for first 30 online minutes; idle taps once per second until first hire and ten post-hire taps. Existing purchase/sales policy retained.
configuration.overnight: 15 active online minutes, real ops simulateAway for 480 away minutes, then 30 active online minutes; activeMinutes=45. No Night Lamp at close: 120 minutes counted at 40% effort.

verification.matchedBaselineBot: Seed 1 active/collect exactly reproduced original first-hour milestones, held 22895, earned 59145, desk letters 872/367.
verification.syntax: node --check tools/balance.mjs and tools/bot.js passed; no dependency installed; no commit or deployment performed.

interpretation: Divide candidate monetary values by 25 for units only; intro, first-hire cost, and machine prices intentionally differ.
Implementation owner confirmed ops hash changes after candidate acceptance were UI/cleanup changes, with no changes to accepted monetary constants, timing, or pickup formula.
Original late reports retain missing relative /tools/library index requests. Empty errors did not cover HTTP statuses. Division income fell back to work count until corrected paired replays.
Identical rooted archive fetch wrapper applied to current and preserved baseline harnesses only. Original runtime and archives remain preserved; earlier raw reports unchanged.
All 18 essential first-hour/overnight reports had no divisions, so absent archive indexes did not affect those financial results.
Partial late runs establish only actual measured durations, not requested horizons. No corrected full prestige cycle or eight-hour online run was measured.
Per-second batched manual presses do not exercise continuous 100-tap bonuses. Browser combo evidence is separate.

Harness simulates ordinary pickup collection schedules, not spawn placement or human collection opportunities. Browser acceptance is separate, and no physical phone or new-player comprehension claim is made.
